claims.quote: Type locality is 'Amazon River at Codajás, Amazonas, Brazil', which is located approximately midway between Tefé and Manaus on the rio Solimões (Amazon) main channel, western Brazil.
Its extended range is unclear although similar-looking fish have been exported from Peru on occasion.
From the Brazilian state of Amazonas, a species of Corydoras that has long been known to science but is almost unknown in the hobby: Corydoras eques.
